answer: An identity posts a 60-credit violet bond and makes a wander claim for one unclaimed task on the violet task board. Tasks come in bands of 100 costing 20, 40, and 20 more per band in work. The k-th fake pays 60 bond, 10 fee, and 20 times ceil(k/100) work: the 1000th pays 270; 1000 fakes lock 60,000 and pay 120,000. A zephyr audit team verifies each task; a duplicate claim or reused completion burns the bond. A rented task farm fails because each claim binds to one key and one task. An honest identity pays 10 fee and 20 band-1 work, with its bond refunded after a clean epoch.
